[[Tree Singer]]s are [[Kurzick]]s who protect and empower the [[Forever Tree]]s. Their songs that they sing, the [[Songs of Arboreum]], serve to keep the Forever Trees from dying, and must be sung annually. If the songs are interrupted then the Forever Trees die and cannot be healed.

==Missions==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|The Eternal Grove}}

==Skills==
14 [[Death Magic]] (19 Death Magic in [[Hard mode]])
*{{skill icon|Death Nova}}

==Dialogue==
When spoken to:
:''"The time has come to awaken the Forever Trees that they might bless us with new [[juggernaut]]s. Have you seen these creatures yet? They were once [[human]]s whose souls [[Gods of Tyria|the gods]] deemed fit to merge with the souls of the Forever Trees. They become the protectors of our lands, and in return, they are much honored and revered."''
:''"The [[Awakening Ceremony|Awakening ceremony]] is sacred; few are the outsiders who have witnessed it. The [[Council of Nobles]], however, feels that the assistance you've provided our people has been invaluable. We therefore bestow upon you the high honor of acting as guardian during the Awakening."''

==Quotes==
:''"A sanctu al defender zu arboretum."''
:''"Par itzkein zein mysterium."''
:''"A eternum al arboreum."''
:''"Per edora resurrekti zu mortikum."''
